messages:
alex: Heads up — noticed ~120 invoices from yesterday where promo discounts didn't apply and net amount is higher. Looks like webhooks replayed out-of-order; invoice.updated arrived after invoice.finalized in some cases. Example invoice id: inv_01Gk9X... Stripe event ordering shows `charge.succeeded` -> `invoice.finalized` -> (later) `invoice.updated`.
maya: Oof. Do we have those events in DLQ or did they get processed by our handler? Any duplicates in NetSuite (credit memos)?
sam: Pulled recent webhook logs and DLQ. Found a cluster of retry entries between 02:10–03:45 UTC where older events were replayed after newer ones. Link to logs: https://internal/logs/stripe-webhooks?query=inv_01Gk9X (internal)
rachel_ops: What window is affected? Is nightly-recon catching them or propagating to AR? Need to know exposure to customers.
alex: Window is ~2026-03-20 02:00–04:30 UTC. nightly-recon flagged 72 mismatches (invoice amount vs NetSuite). I pasted a sample webhook ordering and payload below for context:\n\n```\n// stripe events observed for inv_01Gk9X\n{ \"id\": \"evt_1\", \"type\": \"invoice.finalized\", \"created\": 1700370000 }\n{ \"id\": \"evt_2\", \"type\": \"invoice.updated\",   \"created\": 1700370050 }\n{ \"id\": \"evt_3\", \"type\": \"invoice.updated\",   \"created\": 1700369900 } // replayed later\n```\nThe handler processed evt_3 after evt_1 because of retry ordering. Since we only dedupe by event.id and apply updates regardless of event.created, older state overwrote the final invoice in our NetSuite mapping logic.
maya: Confirmed — our webhook consumer does not enforce per-invoice causal ordering. We keep last-applied `event_id` set but don't check `event.created`/sequence. If an older event replays after a newer one, we naively apply it.
sam: I have a minimal fix ready: track `last_event_ts` per invoice (Redis) and ignore events with `created <= last_event_ts`. Will open PR for canary. Concern: if we ignore, we might drop legitimate out-of-order updates that actually should take effect (rare). We can instead enqueue older events to a FIFO retry buffer, but that's more involved.
alex: For affected invoices, what's the mitigation/backfill? NetSuite shows missing credit memos for those promos.
billing-bot: Auto-report: Daily reconciliation job #daily-recon found 72 mismatches. Job: /jobs/1234. Summary: invoice total != synced allocation for 72 rows.
rachel_ops: Finance needs a list of affected invoices + amounts to approve any NetSuite journal/backfill. @maya can you prepare CSV and run a dry-run backfill first?
maya: On it. Exporting invoice ids + delta amounts now. Dry-run command I plan to use:\n\n```\npython scripts/backfill_credits.py --source stripe --ids /secure-drive/finance/out_of_order_ids.csv --dry-run\n```\nsam: PR: https://internal/git/stripe-webhook-consumer/pull/489 — change summary: store `last_event_ts` per invoice, ignore older events, emit metric `webhook.out_of_order.ignored`. Canary plan: stage for 1h, then prod on 10% traffic for 2h.
alex: Also add alert: if out_of_order > 1/min or total_discrepancy > $5000 in 1h, page eng-sre.
maya: I'll add e2e test simulating delayed event arrival and include a case where `invoice.updated` after `finalized` should be applied when newer.
rachel_ops: Finance approval note: will approve backfill for discrepancies under $5k total per run. Please include totals in dry-run report.
alex: Assigning owners: @sam deploy canary for ordering fix; @maya run dry-run and then run backfill once finance signs off. Sync at 11:30 PST for status.
sam: Canary started on staging. Relevant log line observed: `WARN - ignored event evt_3 for inv_01Gk9X (event.created 1700369900 <= last_event_ts 1700370050)` — behavior looks correct :eyes:
maya: Dry-run output: 120 potential credit lines, total delta $4,280. CSV uploaded to /secure-drive/finance/out_of_order_ids.csv. Proceeding to prod backfill with rate limit 5/s now.
billing-bot: Backfill job started: job_id=98765. ETA ~20m. Link: /jobs/98765
rachel_ops: Finance: approved. If NetSuite needs manual apply for any jet-lagged journals, ping me.
alex: Thanks team. Created postmortem ticket FIN-456 to capture timeline, RCA, and preventative steps (ordering enforce, metrics, e2e). Will draft and share.
sam: Will follow up with PR for metrics + alert threshold. If anything weird shows up in NetSuite after backfill I'll escalate.
maya: I'll post completion note once backfill job finishes and confirm nightly-recon reconciles cleanly.
rachel_ops: :thumbsup: thanks everyone
